tools.name: trit_decide
tools.description:
Scalar ternary decision engine. Pass in floating-point evidence signals on [-1.0, +1.0]. Returns a continuous scalar temperature, a discrete ternary decision (reject/tend/affirm), and a confidence score.

The three zones:
  affirm  (+0.33, +1.0] — signal is affirmative. Act if confidence is high enough.
  tend    [-0.33, +0.33] — deliberation zone. Do NOT act. Gather more evidence.
  reject  [-1.0, -0.33) — signal is negative. Do not proceed.

The 'tend' zone is the key innovation: it is not null or undecided — it is an active computational instruction to remain in uncertainty until the scalar clears a boundary. Confidence tells you HOW decisive the signal is within its zone.

evidence.description: Array of numeric evidence signals on [-1.0, +1.0]. Positive = supporting, negative = contradicting, near-zero = uncertain.

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence threshold for is_actionable (0.0–1.0). Default 0.0.

annotations.title: Trit Decide — Scalar Evidence → Ternary Decision

tools.name: trit_vector
tools.description:
Multi-dimensional ternary evidence aggregation. The full agent reasoning tool.

Provide named evidence dimensions, each with a scalar value [-1.0, +1.0] and an importance weight. The engine computes a weighted-mean aggregate TritScalar and returns aggregate, breakdown, dominant, and recommendation.

dimensions.description: Array of evidence dimensions. Each: {label: string, value: number [-1,1], weight: number >= 0 (default 1.0)}

tools.name: trit_consensus
tools.description: Compute balanced ternary consensus between two trit signals. Consensus is the core ternary addition operator: truth+conflict=hold, truth+truth=truth, conflict+conflict=conflict.

tools.name: trit_eval
tools.description:
Evaluate a ternary expression using the BET (Balanced Ternary Execution) VM.

Supports: consensus(a,b), invert(x), truth(), hold(), conflict(), arithmetic (+, -, *), let bindings.

expression.description: A ternlang expression or statement. E.g. 'consensus(1, -1)' or 'let x: trit = 1; return -x;'

annotations.title: Trit Eval — BET VM Expression Evaluator

tools.name: ternlang_run
tools.description: Compile and execute a full ternlang (.tern) program on the BET VM. Returns register state after execution.

code.description: Full ternlang source code to compile and run.

annotations.title: Ternlang Run — Execute .tern Programs on BET VM

tools.name: quantize_weights
tools.description: Quantize an array of float weights to balanced ternary (-1, 0, +1) using BitNet-style thresholding. Returns the trit vector and sparsity statistics.

threshold.description: Quantization threshold. Omit to auto-compute via BitNet formula.

tools.name: sparse_benchmark
tools.description: Run sparse vs dense ternary matrix multiply benchmark. Shows how many multiply-accumulate operations are skipped due to zero-state (hold) weights. Demonstrates the computational efficiency of ternary AI inference.

weights.description: Flat row-major float weights. Length must equal rows×cols. Omit for demo.

annotations.title: Sparse Benchmark — Ternary Matmul Efficiency (up to 122x)

tools.name: moe_orchestrate
tools.description: Full MoE-13 ternary orchestration pass. Routes your query through a pool of 13 domain experts using dual-key synergistic routing. Safety hard gate fires FIRST. Returns: trit decision, confidence, held flag, safety_vetoed flag, temperature hint, prompt_hint, triad field details, and per-expert verdicts.

query.description: The question or decision to orchestrate.

evidence.description: 6-element evidence vector: [syntax, world_knowledge, reasoning, tool_use, persona, safety]. Values on [-1.0, +1.0]. Omit for neutral.

tools.name: moe_deliberate
tools.description: EMA-based ternary deliberation engine. Models iterative reasoning: given an initial scalar signal and a series of incoming evidence updates, the engine converges toward a stable ternary decision using exponential moving average. Returns round-by-round trace.

target_confidence.description: Confidence threshold to stop deliberating (0.0–1.0). Default 0.8.

max_rounds.description: Maximum deliberation rounds before returning tend. Default 10.

evidence_updates.description: Sequence of incoming evidence scalars, one per round.

annotations.title: MoE Deliberate — EMA Iterative Convergence Engine

tools.name: trit_action_gate
tools.description: Multi-dimensional ternary action gate with hard-block safety veto. Any dimension marked hard_block:true with a negative trit VETOES the action unconditionally. Non-hard-block dimensions contribute to a weighted vote. Returns Pass, Blocked, or Hold.

dimensions.description: Array of gate dimensions. Each: {label, trit (-1/0/1), weight (default 1.0), hard_block (default false)}

hard_block.description: If true, a negative trit VETOES regardless of all other dims.

annotations.title: Trit Action Gate — Safety Veto + Weighted Vote

tools.name: trit_debate
tools.description: Give two competing claims — get a structured 3-way verdict. Routes each claim through MoE-13 independently, compares verdicts, and surfaces the tension between them. Returns: for_a, for_b, tension, synthesis, verdict (AGREEMENT / CONFLICT / HOLD).

claim_a.description: First claim or position to evaluate.

claim_b.description: Second claim or position to evaluate.

context.description: Optional background context shared by both claims.

annotations.title: Trit Debate — Structured 3-Way Verdict on Competing Claims

tools.name: trit_uncertainty_map
tools.description: Paste any text and get every sentence or paragraph annotated with a ternary signal (affirm/tend/reject) and a confidence score. The tend annotations mark claims the text hedges, qualifies, or leaves open — areas that need verification before acting.

annotations.title: Trit Uncertainty Map — Text Annotation by Confidence

tools.name: trit_calibrate
tools.description: Feed an AI agent's recent decision log and get a calibration report. Detects binary habituation: how often did the agent force YES/NO when it should have held? Returns binary_ratio, hold_opportunities, calibration_score, recommendations, and flagged decisions.

decisions.description: Array of recent agent decisions. Each: {input: string, output: string, confidence?: number 0–1}

tools.name: trit_translate
tools.description: Input Python if/elif/else, SQL CASE WHEN, or a JSON rule array — output the equivalent .tern program with the ternary hold zone inserted where the original code had no coverage. Makes the 'else gap' explicit as a Tend arm.

annotations.title: Trit Translate — Binary Code → Ternary .tern Programs

tools.name: trit_eco_check
tools.description: Given a proposed action, returns two trit scores: one from a human-centric perspective (MoE-13) and one from an ecocentric perspective (EcoCore). When they diverge, synthesis is Tend — 'this needs more consideration before acting.' The first MCP tool that asks: is this good for everything, not just us?

action.description: The proposed action or decision to evaluate.

scope.description: Impact scope (default: local). Broader scope amplifies ecological weight.

annotations.title: Trit Eco Check — Human + Ecocentric Dual Perspective

tools.name: trit_audit
tools.description: Full ternary audit of an AI system's decision log. Answers: 'how binary is this AI's decision-making, and would a regulator flag it?' Returns: decision counts, forced_binary_ratio, EU AI Act heuristic (Article 13 transparency + Article 14 human oversight), calibration score, and flagged decisions.

decisions.description: Array of AI decisions to audit. Each: {input: string, output: string, confidence?: number 0–1}

annotations.title: Trit Audit — EU AI Act Compliance Report

tools.name: get_industrial_standards
tools.description: Returns the list of current triadic industrial standards published by RFI-IRFOS. Use this to determine compliance requirements for tokenization, memory, compute, and hardware access.

annotations.title: Get Industrial Standards — RFI-IRFOS Triadic Standards

tools.name: audit_ternary_logic
tools.description: Performs a compliance audit on a snippet of Ternlang or triadic-inspired code. Detects 'Binary Habituation' (over-reliance on true/false) and suggests 'Deliberation Injection' to break binary logic drifts. Reports sparsity potential and MoE-13 safety gate alignment.

code.description: The code snippet to audit for triadic compliance.

annotations.title: Audit Ternary Logic — Triadic Code Compliance Check

tools.name: tsql_join
tools.description: Enterprise T-SQL Triadic Join. Unlike binary SQL (Match/No-Match), a T-Join routes partial matches into a Deliberative Hold (State 0) for escrow audit. Guarantees 100% data retention for high-frequency trading and defense datasets.

annotations.title: T-SQL Join — Ternary Triadic Database Join
